summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted for acute respiratory failure due to severe airway stenosis from relapsing polychondritis. He underwent placement of a covered stent in the left mainstem bronchus, along with balloon dilation and steroid injection. The procedure was complicated by transient hypotension, managed with phenylephrine. Postoperatively, he required brief oxygen support and developed a procedural fever that resolved without antibiotics. He remained stable with improved breathing, was weaned off oxygen, and discharged home with new nebulizer treatments and follow-up plans in rheumatology and interventional pulmonology.
problems: Other diseases of trachea and bronchus
